units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 9</cite> (expl. <he>בשוליה</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">ib.</cite>) <he>בשִׁיפּוּלֶיהָ</he> on her skirts.
<cite ref="Shabbat 98b:10">Sabb. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>לאשה … ושפוליה וכ׳</he> like a woman that walks in the street, and her train drags behind her.
Tosef. Ohol. XIII, 9 שִׁיפּוּלֵי אוהלין the train of tents; (Ohol. VII, 2, v. שִׁיפּוּעַ); a. e.—שיפולי מעים the lower part of the abdomen.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 9:8">Nidd. IX, 8</cite> contrad. to <cite ref="K01243"><he>כרס</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 80b:6">Yeb. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שאין לה ש׳ מ׳ כנשים</he> a woman the formation of whose lower abdomen is not that usual with women.
